text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Tamamo Cross is doing some warm-ups
before
training when...

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
That's strange... My legs aren't movin'
how I want
'em to...

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Nah, I can't be stumblin' over somethin'
this small.
Everyone else is workin' just as
hard as I am.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
I've gotta win me a ton of races, get nice
'n
famous, and set the fam up so they
can live easy!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Maybe the race fatigue is getting to
her...  Looks
like I need to rethink her
upcoming race schedule.
